<!-- Adding or updating a server? Check each item. -->

- [ ] `servers/<id>.json` and `icons/<id>.svg` use the same lowercase kebab-case `<id>`
- [ ] `<id>` is listed in `index.json`
- [ ] Endpoint or package is the server's official one, and I have tried it
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data in the JSON
- [ ] Icon comes from the brand's official assets or Simple Icons
- [ ] `bun run validate` passes
